offers_products.reason: Sells technology platforms like DAAP and the self-service Natural Language Audience Builder, plus audience data.

offers_services.reason: Runs managed omnichannel pharma ad campaigns and point-of-care activation for brands and agencies.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are pharma brands and agencies; patients are only the audience reached, not buyers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to life sciences companies and their agencies.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes from brand campaign budgets, which are mostly per-campaign and not committed subscriptions.

cyclical_demand.reason: Pharma advertising and marketing budgets can be cut or postponed in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Campaign buys are frequent, flexible media spend, not large one-time purchases like machinery or homes.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes mainly from its data, EHR network and targeting platform, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are world-leading life sciences companies and their agencies.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset-light data and software platform with no plants or fleets needed to grow.

notes: Product versus service is a judgment call, since the business mixes a tech platform with managed campaign work.
